title: 5 million servers still lack a fix for 2 critical flaws
description:
OpenAI's Sam Altman says defenders can no longer patch every flaw AI finds, and wants the same AI turned into a new kind of defense shield.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-october-25-2026/

In the headlines (TCR #262):
- Sam Altman says AI-found flaws outpace patching; 1.5 million PHP servers report potentially affected versions
- Block's Dessa voice model learns from human speech alone and runs on a MacBook Pro
- Pennsylvania labels misleading AI ads from December 21; Brazil's court gives Meta and X 24 hours
- Mississippi seeks up to $6.1 million from SpaceXAI; Google cleared about 250,000 trees in Finland
- Proton hosts a map of more than 300,000 Flock surveillance devices on Swiss servers
- Amgen's Imdelltra plus Imfinzi lifts median small cell lung cancer survival to 21.1 months from 12.7
